title: Beyza Receives the MSc Psychology Research Excellence Prize
excerpt: Di Fu congratulated her MSc dissertation student Beyza Akyıldız-Greenhalgh on receiving the Research Excellence Prize at Surrey’s MSc Psychology Summer Conference 2025.

zh.title: Beyza荣获心理学硕士研究卓越奖
zh.excerpt: Di Fu 祝贺其硕士论文学生 Beyza Akyıldız-Greenhalgh 获得萨里大学 2025 年心理学硕士夏季会议的研究优秀奖。
